# Tatiana Paula da Cruz

PhD Candidate in the Department of Political Science at the University of
Wisconsin–Madison. She studies judicial politics and democratic backsliding, with a
focus on how constitutional courts defend their independence against sustained populist
attacks — developed through the Brazilian Supreme Federal Court. Related interests:
public opinion toward courts, the politics of religion and electoral behaviour in Brazil,
and survey-experimental methods. Trained as a lawyer in Brazil before the PhD.
